Video said to show Mali army in Kidal after retaking city | Newsfeed | Al Jazeera
Video said to show Mali army in Kidal after retaking city
Recently published video is said to show Mali’s armed forces in Kidal after retaking the strategic northern city from Tuareg separatists. It would be a major symbolic gain for Mali’s military government, which lost the city to separatists six months ago.
